rhyan douglas.bio: Brampton singer-songwriter Rhyan Douglas is a Canadian artist whose atmospheric music blends contemporary R&B, folk and soul around guitar, ethereal production and a flexible falsetto.

ryland james.bio: Deseronto, Ontario singer-songwriter and pianist Ryland James is a Canadian pop and soul vocalist whose powerful delivery draws on gospel roots and contemporary songwriting.

sadboi.bio: Toronto singer and songwriter SadBoi, formerly known as Ebhoni, is a Canadian alternative-R&B artist whose music draws on dancehall, reggae, soca and contemporary pop.

sean jones.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Sean Jones is a Canadian R&B vocalist who first broke through with the Juno-winning group In Essence before developing a solo career rooted in classic soul.

sebutones.bio: Halifax duo Sebutones was an early Canadian experimental hip-hop project formed by Buck 65 and Sixtoo, pushing the city's 1990s underground rap scene toward abstract production and left-field lyricism.

shaqisdope.bio: Toronto-born rapper ShaqIsDope is a Canadian hip-hop artist whose introspective lyricism and polished independent releases grew from the city's competitive underground rap scene.

sky.bio: Montréal group Sky was a Canadian R&B-influenced pop-rock act whose self-produced debut Piece of Paradise produced major national radio hits and a Juno Award for New Group of the Year.

softcult.bio: Kitchener twin duo Softcult is a Canadian alternative-rock project combining grunge, shoegaze, dream pop and riot-grrrl-inspired DIY values with socially conscious songwriting.

sofia camara.bio: Portugal-born, Toronto-raised singer-songwriter Sofia Camara is a Portuguese-Canadian pop artist known for powerhouse vocals and emotionally direct ballads that have built a rapidly growing international audience.

sofia ly.bio: Montréal singer-songwriter Sofia Ly is a Canadian pop and R&B artist whose powerful vocals gained early attention through The Voice before she began releasing original music.

sophie powers.bio: Toronto-born singer-songwriter and designer Sophie Powers is a Canadian artist whose genre-blurring music combines hyperpop, pop-punk, electropop and hip-hop.

spitty.bio: Brampton rapper and community leader Spitty is an Indian-Canadian hip-hop artist whose music blends South Asian samples and instrumentation with North American rap influences.

sugar jones.bio: Toronto group Sugar Jones was a Canadian pop and R&B girl group created through the first season of Popstars, scoring national radio hits and a platinum-certified debut album in 2001.

sunny malton.bio: Toronto-born Punjabi-Canadian rapper and singer Sunny Malton is a major figure in modern Punjabi hip-hop, known for his work with Sidhu Moose Wala and the Brown Boys collective.
